Je, mamla ka∙e hukumko ra∙bianiko dakgipa Company-ara Ferrosilicon-

watataha jenan mamlao susachakgipa/pota man∙gipa gong 10,00,000/- gamaha 
aro gong 36,79,89-mang gamna bangki dongkuengachim. 
 
6. 
12.10.2011 tariko, section 120-B/418/520 IPC-ni ning∙o jean ia ong∙enggipa 
mamlani miksongani ong∙achim uano pangchake ia mamlao ra∙bianiko dakgipani 
ge∙etanichi Umiam Police Station-o FIR No.43(10) of 2011-ko segataha. 
 
7. 
31.10.2011 tariko, skia man∙begipa  Additional District Magistrate, Nongpoh,

on∙ani) mamlao susachakgipa dolna/ pota man∙gipana hukumko on∙aha. 
 
 
8. 
Gipin sakkirangde golmalo ong∙a. Mamla ka∙e  ra∙bianiko dakgipani aganani

ru∙utani sudko gamna ku∙rachakaha. 
 
9.

susachakgipa dol/ pota man∙gipa tangka gong 40,00,000/- ko gamaniko dakaha 
aro dongkuenggipa bangki tangkana gong 31,34,489/-na payee chequeko on∙aha. 
Agangimin chequeko mamla ka∙e ra∙bigipa uamangni bankerna (uamang kamko

14. 
Mamlao susachakgipa/ pota man∙gipani aganani gita, mamlako ra∙bianiko
